reports.title: Janus Living Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Increases Full Year 2026 Guidance

guidance.heading: GUIDANCE
section: Janus Living's 2026 guidance ranges are updated as follows:

Full Year 2026 | As of 8/4/26 | As of 11/2/26 | Midpoint Change
Diluted earnings per common share | $0.34 | - | $0.37 | $0.08 | - | $0.10 | $0.27 decrease(1)
Diluted FFO as Adjusted per share | $0.95 | - | $0.98 | $0.97 | - | $0.99 | $0.02 increase
Same-Store Adjusted NOI Growth | 13% | - | 17% | 16% | - | 19% | 250 bps increase

(1) The decrease in diluted earnings per common share guidance is primarily due to depreciation and amortization associated with senior housing acquisitions closed during the third quarter and through October 30, 2026. Depreciation and amortization is excluded from Nareit FFO and FFO as Adjusted, so this change has no impact on FFO as Adjusted guidance.
